name: Beetmachine (VST3)
description: The kit that plays the three drum synthesisers. Eight slots, each empty or holding a real Kickstart, Snare Tactics or Hats Off, and a click on a slot opens that drum's own full panel underneath. A MIDI pattern from C3 upwards, or on the General MIDI notes, plays a whole kit. Any slot can cut off any other, so a closed hat chokes the open one; each slot has its level, pan, mute and solo, and goes to the stereo mix, to its own output, or both. Empty slots cost nothing. Ten themed kits, from STUDIO and 808 to DUB, INDUSTRIAL and LO-FI.
note: Windows VST3 + standalone · build 260926.4 · free download · 8 slots · Kickstart, Snare Tactics, Hats Off inside · chokes · 8 extra outputs · 10 kits · manual included.
